dialogues.jp: 神社はいい。
dialogues.en: The shrine will do just fine.
dialogues.text: The shrine will do just fine.

dialogues.jp:
小うるさいガキも来なければ、車の騒音を気に
病むこともない。
dialogues.en:
Now that the noisy little things are gone, just the ambient
sounds of nature remained.
dialogues.text:
Now that the noisy little things are gone, just the ambient
sounds of nature remained.

dialogues.jp:
じじむさい気もするが、落ち着いたところでの
んびりするのが好きな俺にとっては、なかなか
にぴったりのところかも知れない。
dialogues.en:
For someone who enjoys peace and quiet, it's no surprise
that I ended up here.
dialogues.text:
For someone who enjoys peace and quiet, it's no surprise
that I ended up here.

dialogues.jp:
爽やかな風と、ほんの少しばかり近い空を眺め
ながら大きく息を吸い込んだ。
dialogues.en:
The refreshing breeze, and the sky that seemed so close... I
breathed it all in deeply.
dialogues.text:
The refreshing breeze, and the sky that seemed so close... I
breathed it all in deeply.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「こんにちは」
dialogues.en: "Good afternoon."
dialogues.text: "Good afternoon."

dialogues.jp: と、声を掛けられる。
dialogues.en: When, a voice called out to me.
dialogues.text: When, a voice called out to me.

dialogues.jp:
振り返ると、環が巫女装束でしめ縄を担いでい
る環がいた。
dialogues.en:
I turned around to see the Miko-uniform-clad Tamaki, with
the Shime rope in her arms.
dialogues.text:
I turned around to see the Miko-uniform-clad Tamaki, with
the Shime rope in her arms.

dialogues.jp: 「しめ縄の取り替えか？」
dialogues.en: "Exchanging the Shime rope?"
dialogues.text: "Exchanging the Shime rope?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。朝倉様は？」
dialogues.en: "Yes. What about you, Asakura-sama?"
dialogues.text: "Yes. What about you, Asakura-sama?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「のんびりするところを探して、ここまで来た」
dialogues.en: "I was searching for a leisurely place, and ended up here."
dialogues.text: "I was searching for a leisurely place, and ended up here."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そうでしたか」
dialogues.en: "I see."
dialogues.text: "I see."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「重そうだな。持ってやるよ」
dialogues.en: "That must be heavy... let me carry it."
dialogues.text: "That must be heavy... let me carry it."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そ、そんな、いいですよ。重いですし」
dialogues.en: "I, I couldn't! It is heavy."
dialogues.text: "I, I couldn't! It is heavy."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「遠慮すんなよ。俺と環の仲だろ？」
dialogues.en: "Don't be so restrained. We're friends, right?"
dialogues.text: "Don't be so restrained. We're friends, right?"

dialogues.jp:
俺は環の持っていたしめ縄を手に取り、肩に担
いだ。
dialogues.en: I firmly took the Shime rope from her shoulder.
dialogues.text: I firmly took the Shime rope from her shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「すみません……」
dialogues.en: "I'm sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm sorry..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、にこやかな笑顔で、環からしめ縄を受け
取る。
dialogues.en: Smiling at her, I slung the rope around my shoulder.
dialogues.text: Smiling at her, I slung the rope around my shoulder.

dialogues.en: Oof...
dialogues.text: Oof...

dialogues.jp:
突然、重力２倍の部屋に閉じこめられたような
感覚だ。
dialogues.en:
I felt like the entire area around me increased in gravity
by a factor of 2.
dialogues.text:
I felt like the entire area around me increased in gravity
by a factor of 2.

dialogues.jp: 想像していたより重かった。
dialogues.en: That was how heavy the rope felt.
dialogues.text: That was how heavy the rope felt.

dialogues.jp: こんなの、一人で持って歩いてたのかよ。
dialogues.en: A person can actually walk while carrying this...?
dialogues.text: A person can actually walk while carrying this...?

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「やっぱり、いいですよ」
dialogues.en: "Please, it's okay..."
dialogues.text: "Please, it's okay..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……気にするな」
dialogues.en: "...Don't worry."
dialogues.text: "...Don't worry."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「こんなに重いの持ってると、怪我するぞ……」
dialogues.en: "You'd injure yourself carrying this thing..."
dialogues.text: "You'd injure yourself carrying this thing..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そ、そんなこと無いですよ。現に、ここまで
　持って来れましたし」
dialogues.en:
"N, not quite... I came all this way carrying it, after
all."
dialogues.text:
"N, not quite... I came all this way carrying it, after
all."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……意地張るなって」
dialogues.en: "...You're really stubborn."
dialogues.text: "...You're really stubborn."

dialogues.jp: 意地張ってるのは、俺かもしれんが。
dialogues.en: Or maybe, the stubborn one was me.
dialogues.text: Or maybe, the stubborn one was me.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……はい。実は重かったです」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, it really was quite heavy."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, it really was quite heavy."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そこの拝殿まで持ってきゃ、いいんだろ？
　……任せておけ」
dialogues.en:
"You need this to be at the front shrine, right? ...Leave it
to me."
dialogues.text:
"You need this to be at the front shrine, right? ...Leave it
to me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「え？　本当ですか？　ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "R, really? Thank you very much..."
dialogues.text: "R, really? Thank you very much..."

dialogues.jp:
よほど重かったんだろう、というのは、環が喜
ぶ顔を見れば一発でわかる。
dialogues.en:
As heavy as it was, Tamaki's bright face was all the
motivation I needed.
dialogues.text:
As heavy as it was, Tamaki's bright face was all the
motivation I needed.

dialogues.jp: やれやれ。
dialogues.en: Man.
dialogues.text: Man.

dialogues.jp: ま、一日一善も、悪くはあるまい。
dialogues.en: Well, spending days like this, isn't a bad thing.
dialogues.text: Well, spending days like this, isn't a bad thing.

dialogues.jp: 「その代わりと、言っては何だが」
dialogues.en: "In return, do me a favour?"
dialogues.text: "In return, do me a favour?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Certainly."
dialogues.text: "Certainly."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと腹が減っててな」
dialogues.en: "I'm feeling a little hungry."
dialogues.text: "I'm feeling a little hungry."

dialogues.jp: 労働の後は、腹が減るものだ。
dialogues.en: After all that physical labour, my stomach was grumbling.
dialogues.text: After all that physical labour, my stomach was grumbling.

dialogues.jp: 「公園のクレープがうまそうなのだ」
dialogues.en: "I could go for some of the park's crepes right now."
dialogues.text: "I could go for some of the park's crepes right now."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「クレープ？　ですか？」
dialogues.en: "A... crepe, you say?"
dialogues.text: "A... crepe, you say?"

dialogues.jp: 環はきょとんと俺を見つめる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki looked at me quizzically.
dialogues.text: Tamaki looked at me quizzically.

dialogues.jp: 「知らない……訳じゃないよな」
dialogues.en: "Don't tell me... you don't know about them."
dialogues.text: "Don't tell me... you don't know about them."

dialogues.jp: 環は静かに頷く。
dialogues.en: Tamaki silently nodded.
dialogues.text: Tamaki silently nodded.

dialogues.jp: 「食べたことない訳じゃ……ないよな」
dialogues.en: "So you mean... you've never eaten one."
dialogues.text: "So you mean... you've never eaten one."

dialogues.jp: 環はふるふると首を横に振る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki shook her head from side to side.
dialogues.text: Tamaki shook her head from side to side.

dialogues.jp: ……先生、天然記念物がここにいます。
dialogues.en:
...Sensei, one of the seven wonders of the world is right
here.
dialogues.text:
...Sensei, one of the seven wonders of the world is right
here.

dialogues.jp:
今どき、クレープを知らない人間がこの世にい
たとは……。
dialogues.en:
Someone who, at this place, in this day and age, has never
heard of the park's crepes...
dialogues.text:
Someone who, at this place, in this day and age, has never
heard of the park's crepes...

dialogues.jp:
神社という場所が俗世間から離れているのか、
はたまた環が特殊なのか……。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki must be really special, working in a place so far
seperated from the rest of the world...
dialogues.text:
Tamaki must be really special, working in a place so far
seperated from the rest of the world...

dialogues.jp: 「じゃ、後でいこうぜ。社会勉強だ」
dialogues.en: "Well then, follow me. It's time for a lesson in society."
dialogues.text: "Well then, follow me. It's time for a lesson in society."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「は、はい」
dialogues.en: "O, okay..."
dialogues.text: "O, okay..."

dialogues.jp: 俺たちは公園に向かった。
dialogues.en: We headed for the park.
dialogues.text: We headed for the park.

dialogues.jp:
公園のクレープ屋バナナンボーは、いつも通り、
女の子たちが並んでいた。
dialogues.en:
As usual for the crepe store, there was a huge line of
mostly females queueing up.
dialogues.text:
As usual for the crepe store, there was a huge line of
mostly females queueing up.

dialogues.jp:
俺はイチゴチョコクレープを、環の分はブルー
ベリークリームを頼み、ベンチに座る。
dialogues.en:
Eventually, we found a bench, me with my strawberry
chocolate crepe, and her with her blueberry cream crepe.
dialogues.text:
Eventually, we found a bench, me with my strawberry
chocolate crepe, and her with her blueberry cream crepe.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これが、クレープですか……」
dialogues.en: "So this is a crepe..."
dialogues.text: "So this is a crepe..."

dialogues.jp:
環は、クレープを持ちながら、横にくるくる回
している。
dialogues.en: Tamaki peered at the crepe from side to side.
dialogues.text: Tamaki peered at the crepe from side to side.

dialogues.jp: まるで、異国の食べ物を見ているような表情だ。
dialogues.en:
It was the curious look someone would give to a foreign
delicacy.
dialogues.text:
It was the curious look someone would give to a foreign
delicacy.

dialogues.jp: ……いや、実際異国の食べ物なんだけどな。
dialogues.en: ...I suppose, in practical terms, that is what a crepe is.
dialogues.text: ...I suppose, in practical terms, that is what a crepe is.

dialogues.jp: 「ま、とにかく食べてみろよ」
dialogues.en: "Just give it a taste."
dialogues.text: "Just give it a taste."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.en: "...O, okay."
dialogues.text: "...O, okay."

dialogues.jp: 俺も、環が食べるまでは何となく食べづらい。
dialogues.en: I watched her closely, waiting to observe her first bite.
dialogues.text: I watched her closely, waiting to observe her first bite.

dialogues.jp:
まあ、『生まれて初めての体験』の、反応を見
たいというのが本当の理由だが。
dialogues.en:
I wanted to see how someone who react to finally finding a
reason why life is wonderful.
dialogues.text:
I wanted to see how someone who react to finally finding a
reason why life is wonderful.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ、あの、朝倉様」
dialogues.en: "U, um, Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "U, um, Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「これは、スプーンは無いんですか？」
dialogues.en: "I don't have a spoon..."
dialogues.text: "I don't have a spoon..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ」
dialogues.en: "I know."
dialogues.text: "I know."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「では、どうやって食べるのですか？」
dialogues.en: "How would one eat this, otherwise?"
dialogues.text: "How would one eat this, otherwise?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そのまま、パクッと」
dialogues.en: "With your fingers, of course."
dialogues.text: "With your fingers, of course."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「そんなことしても、大丈夫なんですか？」
dialogues.en: "Would that really be... alright?"
dialogues.text: "Would that really be... alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「何がだよ」
dialogues.en: "What could be wrong?"
dialogues.text: "What could be wrong?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「クリームがこぼれたりはしないのですか？」
dialogues.en: "Won't the cream spill over?"
dialogues.text: "Won't the cream spill over?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「少しはこぼれるだろうが、それをうまい具合
　に食べるのがいいのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Letting a little spill over, only makes the taste that much
better."
dialogues.text:
"Letting a little spill over, only makes the taste that much
better."

dialogues.jp:
うまく食べられなくても『あーん、ほっぺにつ
いちゃったー』とか『こぼれちゃうー』とか言
いながら食べるのもまたいいのだ。
dialogues.en:
Well, not really, but there's something about smearing a
little on your cheek, and exclaiming about it.
dialogues.text:
Well, not really, but there's something about smearing a
little on your cheek, and exclaiming about it.

dialogues.jp: ──ちょっと、見てみたいかも。
dialogues.en: ---I kinda want to see how that'd look on her.
dialogues.text: ---I kinda want to see how that'd look on her.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、ほっぺに白いクリームをつけた環の慌て
る顔を想像した。
dialogues.en:
My imagination was quickly crafting an image of Tamaki with
white cream smeared on her cheek.
dialogues.text:
My imagination was quickly crafting an image of Tamaki with
white cream smeared on her cheek.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「はい。じゃあ、思い切って」
dialogues.en: "Okay... then with no further delay,"
dialogues.text: "Okay... then with no further delay,"

dialogues.jp:
環はクレープを一瞬見つめ、意を決するように
深呼吸すると、頭からかじりついた。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki gave the crepe one final glance, then steadfastedly
lowered her head.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki gave the crepe one final glance, then steadfastedly
lowered her head.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「あ！　おいしい」
dialogues.en: "...It's delicious."
dialogues.text: "...It's delicious."

dialogues.jp: 環はぱっと笑顔になる。
dialogues.en: Tamaki's face suddenly broke out in a smile.
dialogues.text: Tamaki's face suddenly broke out in a smile.

dialogues.jp:
いつものような上品な笑い方ではなく、子供が
宝物を発見したときのような笑顔……。
dialogues.en:
Not the usual elegant and refined smile, but one of pure
innocence and enjoyment, like a kid's smile.
dialogues.text:
Not the usual elegant and refined smile, but one of pure
innocence and enjoyment, like a kid's smile.

dialogues.jp: 俺はとても微笑ましい気持ちになる。
dialogues.en: It was a smile so infectious, it was making me smile too.
dialogues.text: It was a smile so infectious, it was making me smile too.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「へえ。普通の女の子は、こういうものを食べ
　るんですね」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... so normal females eat this sort of thing."
dialogues.text: "Hmm... so normal females eat this sort of thing."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「環だって、普通の女の子じゃないか？」
dialogues.en: "You're a normal female too, no?"
dialogues.text: "You're a normal female too, no?"

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「そうでしょうか？　でも皆さんが知っている
　ことを知らないんですもの」
dialogues.en:
"You think so? There are things everyone feels are
suspicious about me..."
dialogues.text:
"You think so? There are things everyone feels are
suspicious about me..."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「でも俺から見たら、環も可愛い普通の女の子
　だと思うけどな」
dialogues.en: "Well, in my eyes, you're simply a normal, cute girl."
dialogues.text: "Well, in my eyes, you're simply a normal, cute girl."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ほ、本当に？　あ、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "R, really? Thank you..."
dialogues.text: "R, really? Thank you..."

dialogues.jp:
と、取り乱して照れていたが、少しすると、い
つもの｛みやび／雅｝な環に戻っていた。
dialogues.en:
Although after a slight bout of nervousness, she quickly
returned to her usual, calm and collected self.
dialogues.text:
Although after a slight bout of nervousness, she quickly
returned to her usual, calm and collected self.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「今日はとても貴重な体験をしました。朝倉様
　のお陰です」
dialogues.en: "My life really has changed today, thanks to Asakura-sama."
dialogues.text: "My life really has changed today, thanks to Asakura-sama."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「俺の方こそ、ごちそうしてもらって悪いね」
dialogues.en: "I had a treat too, no need to thank me."
dialogues.text: "I had a treat too, no need to thank me."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ。荷物まで運んでもらった上に、クレー
　プを教えてくれたんですもの」
dialogues.en:
"No... you helped me carry the rope, and introduced me to
crepes."
dialogues.text:
"No... you helped me carry the rope, and introduced me to
crepes."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「また、ぜひ色々、教えて下さいね」
dialogues.en: "Please teach me more things in the future."
dialogues.text: "Please teach me more things in the future."

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「ああ、なんでも聞いてくれ」
dialogues.en: "Of course, as long as you're willing to listen."
dialogues.text: "Of course, as long as you're willing to listen."

dialogues.jp:
クレープごときでこんなに喜んでもらえるなら、
何だって教えてやりたくなる。
dialogues.en:
With her getting so excited about the crepe, it certainly
made me want to introduce more new things to her.
dialogues.text:
With her getting so excited about the crepe, it certainly
made me want to introduce more new things to her.

dialogues.jp: 俺と環は公園を後にし、神社へと戻った。
dialogues.en: We left the park together, in the direction of the shrine.
dialogues.text: We left the park together, in the direction of the shrine.

dialogues.jp: ◆クレープの感動◆
dialogues.en: ◆Crepe's Excitement?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Crepe's Excitement?◆

dialogues.jp:
神社に行くと、重いしめ縄の取り替えをやって
いる環に出会った。
dialogues.en: At the shrine, I saw Tamaki lugging a heavy object around.
dialogues.text: At the shrine, I saw Tamaki lugging a heavy object around.

dialogues.jp:
あまりに重そうなので、俺は取り替えを手伝っ
てやることにした。
dialogues.en:
Seeing the sorry sight, I took it from her and carried it
myslf.
dialogues.text:
Seeing the sorry sight, I took it from her and carried it
myslf.

dialogues.jp:
環があまりに申し訳なさそうにするので、代わ
りに、公園のクレープをおごってもらうことに
した。
dialogues.en:
As a thanks for my labour, she treated us to crepes at the
Sakura Park.
dialogues.text:
As a thanks for my labour, she treated us to crepes at the
Sakura Park.

dialogues.jp:
環は初めてクレープを食べるらしく、とても感
動していた。
dialogues.en:
It was the first time Tamaki had tried crepes, and she was
greatly moved by it.
dialogues.text:
It was the first time Tamaki had tried crepes, and she was
greatly moved by it.

dialogues.jp: こんな感動なら、お安いごようだ。
dialogues.en: Such a wonderful feeling.
dialogues.text: Such a wonderful feeling.
